newsitem.title: USA: Conseco unit to offer preferred securities.
newsitem.headline: Conseco unit to offer preferred securities.

text.p: Conseco Inc said Friday its Conseco Financing Trust I subsidiary plans to offer eight million trust-originated preferred securities, which have a liquidation amount of $25 per preferred security.
The securities will be fully and unconditionally guaranteed by Conseco, it said.
Merrill Lynch & Co, Dean Witter Reynolds Inc, Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, PaineWebber Inc, Prudential Securities Inc and Sand Brothers & Co Ltd will manage the offering.
Proceeds will be used to repay bank debt.
